name: POST to Rayvn log
info:
Uploads attachments and posts an entry to the Rayvn log.

### Input
Msg after Bridge to Rayvn:
- `msg.entry`                 — original bridge entry (files with context_keys)
- `msg.metadata`              — same object as entry.metadata (set by Bridge to Rayvn)
- `msg.metadata.failed_files` — failures accumulated on the GET side (classify + download)
- `msg.payload`               — Rayvn-formatted entry with files = entry.files

### Logic
1. Upload files to Rayvn: uploads buffers from global context. Replaces
   msg.payload.files with Rayvn file IDs. Upload failures are added to
   msg.metadata.failed_files (= entry.metadata.failed_files, same object).
2. Patch receiver text: patches msg.payload.text with a complete receiver notice
   based on the now-complete failure picture (classify + download + upload).
3. Format header and url + delay + HTTP POST.
4. Return response: sets msg.result.
5. Simple notification trigger: fires sender notification via link-call
   if POST succeeded and attachment failures exist.

### Output 1
POST response (msg.result set by Return response).

### Notifications
Fired directly to attachment notification (System handling) via internal link-call.
